governance.exitCriteria: A workspace can install, update and remove a marketplace plugin without an operator touching the database, and an install survives a plugin version bump.
governance.dataMigration: An installation row records the plugin version it was written against, and removal archives the row rather than deleting it, so a workspace that installed during the beta keeps its history.
governance.support: Answered on the normal support queue; a failed install is a defect, and a plugin author's own bug is referred to that author.

governance.exitCriteria: Every hook event a surface can raise is declared in the shared contract, and a hook that fails or times out leaves the run it was attached to in a state the user can read.
governance.dataMigration: Hook definitions are stored per workspace with the contract version that wrote them; an unknown event name is retained and skipped rather than dropped.
governance.support: Best effort while beta: a hook that does not fire is investigated, a hook script's own failure is the author's.

governance.exitCriteria: A browser session survives a page navigation and a tab close without stranding the run, and every action the model takes is attributable to a session the user opened.
governance.dataMigration: Sessions are transient; nothing written by the beta outlives the session, so widening it migrates no stored row.
governance.support: Answered on the normal support queue; a site that blocks automation is reported, not treated as a defect.

governance.exitCriteria: Every action is approved or replayable, the user can stop a run mid-action, and no action reaches a screen the user did not hand over.
governance.dataMigration: Screenshots and action logs are held for the life of the session only; nothing an experimental run wrote needs migrating when it widens.
governance.support: Experimental: reported defects are triaged but carry no response commitment, and the feature can be withdrawn between releases.

governance.exitCriteria: A device pairing can be revoked from either side and takes effect on the next request, and a controlled device shows the user that it is being controlled for as long as it is.
governance.dataMigration: Pairings carry the protocol version that created them; revoking a pairing keeps its audit trail, so no experimental pairing is silently erased when it widens.
governance.support: Experimental: reported defects are triaged but carry no response commitment, and the feature can be withdrawn between releases.

governance.exitCriteria: A trigger fires once per event, a run it started is attributable to the event that started it, and pausing a trigger stops it without deleting its history.
governance.dataMigration: Trigger definitions carry the event contract version they were written against; an event name a newer contract renamed keeps its old name on stored rows until the trigger is edited.
governance.support: Answered on the normal support queue; a missed fire is a defect, a third party's webhook not arriving is not.
